=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:407 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `--jq` marker filter in `gate_fetch_marker_comments` no longer has the `or ($b | contains("<!-- ai:final-ci-repair-request:v1 "))` clause, which main added for #10063. The [ai-merge-resolve] commit 10dda22 dropped it when it added the `ai:merge-resolve` clause. As a result, bot-authored judge repair-request comments never reach `gate_marker_comments_file`, and non-Bot ones are reduced to `activity_only` records with an empty body.
  WHY: The readers at line 496, line 789 (also 603 per z-ai_glm-5_3-flash) and line 2002 never see the request, so the gate ends with `AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP reason=clean_same_head` and the #10063 final-CI repair never runs. CI run 46094745633 confirms this through failures in test_final_ci_repair_accepts_judge_repair_request_marker, test_final_ci_repair_accepts_an_integration_branch_base, test_final_ci_repair_request_keeps_the_caps and test_gate_script_wiring. All reviewers rated it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:57-61 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` is split into two assignments again (the 10dda22 merge brought back the split that the earlier editor run removed). `review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh` and `review_autofix_step_editor_noop_suspicious_warning.sh` now sit only in the line-61 append. The contract test's first-match regex `^REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS="([^"]*)"` (tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py:130-136) cannot see them.
  WHY: The required CI job tests-promote-stall-and-review fails with `AssertionError: review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh must be staged via REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` (run 46094745633), which blocks the merge. Reviewers disagree on runtime impact:
    - most say the effective shell variable still holds both names;
    - google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and minimax_minimax-m3 claim runtime bootstrap or step failures;
    - minimax_minimax-m3 also filed a separate MAJOR finding that the split leaves only the first assignment auditable.
  The highest severity, BLOCKER, is used and mapped to critical.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh (via orchestrate-poll workflow integration):Overall resolution logic for merge-base integration | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Integration fingerprint verification failed because the must_not_exist path backend/file_back.py reappeared after the [ai-merge-resolve] operation.
  WHY: The conflict resolver reverts a file deletion that was meant to be permanent, which makes the integration fail during sync. The source rated it BLOCKER, mapped here to critical.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The new bootstrap script `review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh` must be staged via the single/primary `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` assignment (repository contract enforced by tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py).
  expected_change_site: scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh (the first `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS="..."` assignment at line 57)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The script is missing from the line-57 assignment and appears only in the secondary assignment on line 61. The regex on line 132 of tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py cannot capture line 61. As a result, tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py:136 raises `AssertionError: review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh must be staged via REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS` and `tests-promote-stall-and-review` fails. The 2026-11-28T01:21:47Z editor run changed only tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py and left this unfixed.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:Line 407. This is the --jq filter in gate_fetch_marker_comments. Its select list now ends `... or ($b | contains("<!-- ai:final-ci-repair:v1 "))) | {id: .id, ...`. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The [ai-merge-resolve] commit 10dda22 added the `<!-- ai:merge-resolve ` clause and dropped `or ($b | contains("<!-- ai:final-ci-repair-request:v1 "))`, which main added for #10063. Bot-authored judge requests are dropped from gate_marker_comments_file, and non-Bot ones survive only as activity_only records with an empty body. The readers at line 496, line 789 and line 2002 miss the marker.
  WHY: The gate falls through to `AUTOFIX_GATE_SKIP reason=clean_same_head`, so the #10063 red-check repair never happens. CI run 46094745633 shows these failures:
    - tests/test_review_autofix_clean_same_head_gate.py::test_final_ci_repair_accepts_judge_repair_request_marker
    - test_final_ci_repair_accepts_an_integration_branch_base
    - tests/test_review_autofix_terminal_same_head_gate.py::test_final_ci_repair_request_keeps_the_caps
    - test_gate_script_wiring, in both files (asserted at line 115)
  Fix: restore the clause after the `ai:final-ci-repair:v1` clause and keep the `ai:merge-resolve` clause.
- scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh:Line 57 is the first `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS="..."` assignment. Line 61 is the second assignment, `REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS="${REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS} review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh review_autofix_step_editor_noop_suspicious_warning.sh"`. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The 10dda22 merge brought back the split list that the earlier editor run had removed. tests/test_review_autofix_step_scripts_contract.py::test_step_scripts_are_required_bootstrap_scripts (lines 130-136) reads only the first match, so review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh is missing from what it checks.
  WHY: tests-promote-stall-and-review fails with `AssertionError: review_autofix_step_mark_review_blocked_exhaustion.sh must be staged via REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS`. Runtime staging still works, but the required check stays red. Fix: move both names back into the line-57 string, delete lines 58-61, and keep review_autofix_step_push_pending_commits.sh where it is.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. All four phases have diff hunks, and the OPTIONAL_KEYS edit in tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py covers the four new MERGE_LEASE_* keys, whose defaults match scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh. The bootstrap-list gap that gemini reported is the stage_workflow_support.sh finding above.
